steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect circuit breaker or power cable before servicing electrical parts. Reconnect panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the circuit breaker or power cable before servicing.

steps.title: Inspect for water leakage
steps.body: Check shutter and base for water traces. Normal: no leakage trace.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check shutter and base for water traces. Normal: no leakage trace.

steps.title: Leak sensor reads >3 V after dry?
steps.body: CN503 pin 2 leakage input: LC when ≤3 V for 3 s. After 3 min drain, sensor should read >3 V if dry.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN503 pin 2 leakage input: LC when ≤3 V for 3 s. After 3 min drain, sensor should read >3 V if dry.

steps.title: Locate and repair leak
steps.body: Find leak at hose, door, sump seals, heater, or pump joints. Repair and dry base.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Find leak at hose, door, sump seals, heater, or pump joints. Repair and dry base.

steps.title: Leak resolved
steps.body: No active leak; sensor dry. Replace main PBA only if leak repaired but LC persists.
steps.oemOutcome: No active leak; sensor dry. Replace main PBA only if leak repaired but LC persists.
